blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `validateCartStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step validates that a cart is eligible for store credit usage. It throws an
error if the cart is not found, does not have a customer, or does not have a
currency set.

children.name: ValidateCartStepInput
children.description: Input to validate that a cart is eligible for store credit usage.
